text:
Priya: quick ask — can someone run a short smoke plan to measure API overhead for the streaming path when using function/tool calls and structured outputs? trying to confirm if the latest routing change added ~10-20ms per token. need p50/p95 for 32/128 tokens and 0/2 toolcalls. ideally by EOD. :eyes:
Lucas: I can set up the permutations. plan: cold vs warm, streaming vs sync, funccalls=0/2, structured output on/off, token lengths 32/128. run 200 samples each. upload raw csv to s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/ and post summary here. sound ok?
Annie: I can run the hosted slices for small model variants (redwood-1-small, redwood-1-base) and do warm/cold. tag me @Lucas on the commands so I can re-run locally if needed.
Jorge: add --kv-warm=true/false to capture KV cache impact. also include --concurrency=1 for single-request latency and --concurrency=8 for steady throughput. quick commands below.

Lucas: ```bash
# example bench command
./bench-run.sh --model redwood-1-base --mode streaming --funccalls 2 --structured true --tokens 128 --concurrency 1 --samples 200 --kv-warm=false --out s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/base_stream_2func_cold.csv
```

TJ: which model quantization should we pick? use fp16 or int8 candidates? we should run one int8 to reflect dedicated profiles.
Maya: +1 to include int8 for dedicated reproduction. also include a run tag so the console can auto-link: tag=rt-overhead-1876543210.
bench-bot: queued job 55813 for s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210 (expected ~18m). status: queued. :gear:

Annie: started running the small-hosted suite now. will post progress updates.
Lucas: allocation notes: please limit runs against prod-hosted to off-peak (after 8pm PDT) or use the dev-hosted cluster. we don't want to impact customer traffic.
Jorge: small reminder — capture both tokens/request and service tokens (token billing) columns in csv. helps when comparing unit cost.

bench-bot: job 55813 started on host dev-infer-03. logging to /var/log/bench/55813.log and streaming to s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/55813_stream_log.txt

Annie: first batch done (redwood-1-small). quick summary: p50=85ms, p95=210ms for streaming+2func+32tokens cold; warm runs drop to p50=68ms p95=160ms. uploading csv now. :arrow_up_small:
Lucas: nice — can you also run the sync path for same params? we want delta streaming vs sync. if sync p50 ~60ms then streaming adds ~8ms.
Annie: running sync now.

TJ: if anyone sees numbers that look like +20ms across all variants that's probably the routing change I pushed yesterday. ping me and I'll revert.
Maya: TL;DR for dashboards: please include `run_tag=rt-overhead-1876543210` and set `deployment=dev-hosted` in the metadata so the console query is straightforward.

bench-bot: job 55813 finished. summary CSVs uploaded:
- s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/base_stream_2func_cold.csv
- s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/base_stream_2func_warm.csv
- s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/base_sync_2func_warm.csv
results snippet (CSV header + first line):
```
metric,p50_ms,p95_ms,model,mode,funccalls,tokens,kv_warm,concurrency
latency,68,160,redwood-1-small,streaming,2,32,true,1
```

Jorge: saw the csv — quick grep shows streaming vs sync delta ~9ms p50 on redwood-1-small, ~12ms p50 on redwood-1-base, int8 had slightly higher p95 tail. posting a short CSV diff to s3.

Priya: excellent. next steps: 1) Lucas to collect and normalize all CSVs into a single summary table 2) TJ to revert routing change if we confirm regression >15ms 3) open a tiny PR with run link + perf summary so PMs can see. can we have that by tomorrow morning?
Lucas: will do normalization + upload summary to s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/summary.csv. ETA tomorrow 9am PT.
TJ: will stand by — if numbers show >15ms regression I'll queue a revert.
Maya: I'll add the `rt-overhead-1876543210` tag in the console and pin the summary to the team dashboard when available.
Annie: filing a short internal note in the perf-runner channel with the raw logs and exact commands I used.

Priya: thanks all! :thumbsup: please mention me when the summary is up.

bench-bot: normalization job 55814 started (collecting CSVs). output: s3://redwood-bench/qa/1876543210/summary.csv

bench-bot: normalization job 55814 finished. summary uploaded. public snippet:
```
model,mode,funccalls,tokens,p50_ms,p95_ms,delta_stream_vs_sync_p50
redwood-1-small,streaming,2,32,68,160,9
redwood-1-small,sync,2,32,59,140,0
redwood-1-base,streaming,2,32,75,190,12
redwood-1-base,sync,2,32,63,170,0
```

Lucas: uploaded a short PR draft with the summary and tags: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-reports/pull/342 — please review.
TJ: looked at the numbers — delta under 15ms, not a hard regression. keeping deploy. thanks for the quick run team.
Priya: great. closing the loop. will post a short note to #eng-status and archive raw s3 folder after 30d. :white_check_mark:
